data.description: Status: provisional-historical. Reference date: 2022-12. Licence: Government Open Data License - India (GODL-India). A third-party mirror of the Local Government Directory as of December 2022. It is NOT a verified current (2026) LGD registry: states, union territories and districts created, merged or renamed after 2022 are missing or differ, and the file could not be compared with the official portal (it requires an image captcha). Treat every resolution against it as provisional.
